messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
june 22 Notes:


I took a few paper trades today while at work and they were actually really good ones. Just paper, but I was at work and it is a no news monday too.
,
Market opened and we traded below the nwog, swept a swing low and then traded through and above the nwog. We made very relative equal highs with previous day highs and the range that expanded to it traded out of the nwog. I marked my fib and took the first 5min that rejected out of discount, but it got stopped out. I then took the next one that hit ote, but it was a big wick and didn’t cover it all with my stop, so I got stopped out again. I was confident in this though so I took one more entry which was the 1min rb that aligned with the ce og the 5min and that was the winning trade. My last trade was a 1:10rr and was triple the amount of the 2 losses combined. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
The next trade that I took was a beautiful limit trade (also paper) that played out beautifully. There was an unmitigated 4h wick that was at all time highs, but the next 4h candle missed it by a few points creating el. I scaled down to the 1h and we had an fvg inside the wick so I set my limit for one point above the bottom of fvg. Market opened at 9:30 and traded into my level with the first candle and instantly sold off to my tp within 3 minutes, great trade. (Screenshots 3-5)
,
What I learned after today is that my actually trading should be more like my paper trading. Have more confidence and just execute off of my ideas and nothing else. Literally just let all my trading do the talking.
,

messages.author: adan087194
messages.content_text:
Don't just set levels as your bias that are like 500 pts. away. If your daily bias is a level that's very far away, wait a little to let price get closer. Or, target a closer level. If you target a super far level with a precision entry, that's a recipe for getting manipulated. The times when you made the best trades were when price was accumulating above/below a target level on the HTF and you entered. (edited)

messages.author: saamson
messages.content_text:
DAY 17  : 2 TRADES 2 L'S

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias was bullish, but since we saw a big expansion overnight, it didn't fully make sense to trade into this session. Though i did, this was something to note and not repeat. On top of that, the stdv to -4 was very close and no trade would have been optimal RR wise. Price even reverse off of -4. I was aniticipating a continuation profile today, and it was , but very choppy. There was only a small window where it would have been possible but there's no way of foreseeing that. First trade was a.. mistake. it was supposed to be a 15 min TFA into 1 min breaker, but i went with a 30 second instead. trade did not play out. i early stopped it. don't do that again. There's a reason it's TFA.

Second trade was same thing, i was just looking for breakers without proper alignment. was annoyed that price didn't tap me in on a trade before, and then used the next leg. the leg did tap OTE of a 1 min fvg, which meant i should've used the 15 sec, but there wasn't anything good there. So i just went around looking for possible breakers that aligned with the OTE being formed. That is pattern trading. and not the model. 

Psychological Analysis
Tired. Made simple mistakes again and bad decisions because of lack of sleep. But honestly it was just the bad decisions alone. Trading after a huge expansion and so close to -4 i was gambling that it would expand further. gambling against the model. Even tilted and tried for a 3rd trade, i cancelled it after a minute but still shows where my head is at right now. Dissapointed in myself for making these mistakes again.

messages.author: Ferrone
messages.content_text:
Day 33
6/22/26
Recap: 1/1 +1.5R; +75pts

I'm feeling decent today, a bit groggy as usual.

Coming into today we had a strong move down sunday evening followed by a rally overnight. This leads me to stay bullish unless we're over extended and want to rebalance. We have a relatively large SMT, NQ has taken multiple highs while ES hasn't with PWH within reach.

At open we manipulate higher with a strong rejection down into OTE.  London lows below. We will see at the macro if we're holding OTE or wanting to trade lower. 

We're holding the OTE and have already went for buyside. Slightly annoying because there was a clean iFVG to the highs that I could've took but I'm currently waiting for the macro today. We are currently retracing again into OTE of the internal range + 1m FVG. For me to take longs here I need to see a hold and BoS back to the upside, but it looks like a shifting trends back lower to LoD. We did actually leaving a bullish SMT that ES took, if we get displacement +BoS back to the upside I will take.

I've got my limit set at a 1m FVG for some longs, see if I get filled. I entered when ES enter it's FVG. Targetting PWH. Exiting at a 1.5R to halfpass my evals.

One and done on the day, overall good execution, good patience waiting for the set up. I could possibly have waited for NQ to hit the FVG but my criteria does allow me to enter if theres matching FVGs with ES and ES taps into it. Obviously using my discretion, but other than that we're 50% to two new fundeds. (edited)

messages.content_text:
Day 32
6/21/26

Its currently Sunday evening. 7 pm est. All weekend I've been in my head. Been thinking a lot about trading and my recent success. Thinking that this might be a fluke, I've had runs like this always end in disaster. And this weekend I've just been feeling like this might be the same thing. I've also been experiencing a lot of fear around money for some reason even though I am in a good position.

For wahtever reason, I decided to come in this evening to trade my fundeds. I don't know if it was boredom, greed, seeing other peoples success on social media. Totally against my rules and my edge. And it goes how you would expect, loss, loss, another loss, followed by another, starts sizing up. Eventually I was in so much drawdown I came to the point where I was like "I'm blowing my funded, there's no coming back tmrw. It's I either win now or lose the accounts." And I did lose one of my fundeds. I also ended up winning almost a $10k trade with 5 minis on my other funded. Even after that I tried entering more. Eventually I closed my last position and locked myself out for tonight as well as tomorrows session.

messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
june 19 Notes:


This was an unfortunate day because it was a bank holiday and I lost two trades trading the london session at work. Good setups, but I am kicking myself for it.
,
We got a big move down during asia and started to retrace during london and I was looking at ote of the range. We swept a high into a 4h gap and tapped the .62 level making a bearish rejection block which I entered off of. I got a decent reaction before seeing a random spike of bullishness up to my stoploss. (Screenshot 1)
,
We then swept the high and tapped the ce of the 4h fvg and made a smt with es and a 1min rb which I entered on and got stopped out on too. (Screenshot 2)
,
Now, neither of these trades were bad. They can be considered as good, but the conditions where just not which is why I have kind of been kicking myself for taking trades on a bank holiday and at work. At the time I felt nothing towards it, but now it is a little disappointing. No worries though, not much damage was done so we move onto the next one and continue improving and learning from mistakes. I have also come to the realisation that I haven’t won a single trade, while trading at work. So my new rule is no more trading at work. I only have two morning to trade now, but it should be enough. It’s also only until september.
,
